name: Orbital Beam
description: Calls down a beam from orbit on a unit or empty tile within %cast_range% tiles, dealing %damage% damage.

upgrade.summary: Deals %damage%, and every pylon calls down another beam anywhere on the map.
details: Each pylon standing adds one more beam, aimed at a random enemy anywhere on the map rather than beside the pylon.
Those beams are aimed independently, so one unlucky enemy can be struck by several of them at once.
They come on top of the volley the pylons already fire at whatever is next to them.
